prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Fire, of the Oxygen Nation — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: her own room in a house of her element's kingdom, its walls and furniture built from the element's materials and colours, a mirror and a window
Time of day: daytime indoors — bright, even light filling the room; daylight bouncing softly off pale walls.
Outfit: a cropped hoodie and short shorts — in graphite grey with black trim; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a relaxed oversized fit and a small jewelled hair clip, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the right of the frame; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the right of the frame; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a cup at chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: an unposed in-between expression, mouth caught mid-shape, brows natural.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — breath and fire and rust in one: cool clear air as translucent cloth, bright combustion orange as accents, the quiet power to corrode, the deep blue of oceans and the green of forests; it is the element of life and burning — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.
